hero.hook: The right illustration doesn't just decorate a project—it defines tone, carries your story, and gives readers something to feel and remember.

about.label: About
about.title: A visual voice built for narrative depth
paragraphs: I'm Adi Badash, an illustrator specializing in children's books, fantasy worlds, and custom artwork. My work is guided by storytelling fit—how well the images interpret your idea, elevate emotion, and stay true to the world you're building.

For publishers and art directors, I bring reliability, clear communication, and a deep understanding of narrative illustration. For families and private clients, I craft one-of-a-kind paintings with the same care for character and feeling.

The best results come from collaboration: a clear brief, mutual trust, and room for creative interpretation—not just execution. I'd love to hear what you want your audience to understand and remember.

process.label: How I work
process.title: Clarity, collaboration, and the right creative fit
process.subtitle: Strong illustration projects depend on more than aesthetics—they depend on purpose, trust, and storytelling alignment.

purpose.title: Define the purpose
purpose.description: We begin with what the illustration needs to do: the audience, the feeling you want to leave behind, and the role of images in your book, brand, or commission.

voice.title: Find the visual voice
voice.description: We look for a storytelling fit—not illustration in general, but a visual language that aligns with your message, characters, and world.

collaborate.title: Collaborate with trust
collaborate.description: Clear communication, thoughtful feedback, and space for interpretation. The strongest work happens when you trust the creative process.

deliver.title: Deliver with intention
deliver.description: Final artwork that doesn't just look beautiful—it becomes a defining part of how your story, brand, or gift is experienced and remembered.
